newsitem.title: USA: Bone Care on schedule with lead drug.
newsitem.headline: Bone Care on schedule with lead drug.

text.p: Bone Care International Inc said Thursday it was on schedule to complete the Phase 3 trial of its lead drug, one-alpha D2.
The test is designed to confirm the efficacy and safety of one-alpha D2 as a treatment for secondary hyperparathyroidism associated with end-stage renal disease, the company said.
Researchers at UCLA recently reported on early data from the trial at the International Symposium on Advances in Renal Osteodystrophy held in Spain.

They found that one-alpha D2 reduced elevated parathyroid hormone levels to the target range in 84 percent of the first 43 patients completing 16 weeks of treatment, the company said. No significant adverse events were observed, the company said.
Earlier Thursday, Bone Care reported a net loss of $825,000, or $0.19 a share, in the third quarter ended March 31, compared with a net loss of $261,000, or $0.10 per share for the year-ago quarter.
